Hi Alex / FinTechCorp Security team —

Thanks for the checklist — below are the IR/BCP responses you requested. I'm providing these at a level appropriate for procurement/security review; happy to schedule a short technical session for more detail.

Incident detection / response (high level):
- Time-to-detect: depends on signal; our SOC/monitoring aims to alert on high-severity events within 15–60 minutes.
- Time-to-contain: containment activities are performed immediately on incidents; for high-severity incidents we expect containment milestones within 24 hours.
- Time-to-notify (customer): We notify affected customers within 72 hours of confirmed exposure. For incidents requiring regulatory notification (e.g., GDPR), we follow applicable timelines (72-hour notification to authorities) and will coordinate customer comms in parallel.
- Escalation / points of contact: Initial IR triage -> IR lead -> Customer Ops. We will provide a named contact for the engagement once the questionnaire is returned.

BCP / DR specifics (targets):
- Authentication/session services: RTO 2 hours / RPO 15 minutes
- Model-serving inference infra (production): RTO 4 hours / RPO 1 hour
- Control-plane API (management/rollouts): RTO 6 hours / RPO 1 hour

Evidence / tests:
- SOC 2: redacted report attached (SOC2-report-redacted.pdf).
- Pen test: last external pentest completed 2026-04; summary and remediation tracker can be provided under NDA.
- BCP tests: tabletop and DR failover exercises are performed quarterly; we can provide the latest exercise summary as part of the upload.

HIPAA / BAA:
- Redwood will sign a BAA that covers subprocessors. We maintain a subprocessors registry and can provide it as part of the standard procurement pack (or include it in the DocuSign BAA flow).

Upload / questionnaire return:
- You can use the DocuSign secure upload or our encrypted upload link (let me know preference).

Happy to join a 30-min call to walk through any of these items — Marissa, are we keeping the Thursday 10/22 10:00am PT slot?
